Concept

Two systems run the server: Charm abilities and RankSMP.

  • Charm SMPCraft charms, equip one per category and trigger their abilities. Nine charms, each with its own cooldown, recipe and effect.Explore
  • RankSMPEvery player holds a rank from #1 to #30. Your rank sets your hearts, potion duration, XP gain and extra inventory.Explore
  • Elo ratingsWin fights to climb. Beating a higher-rated player is worth more than beating a lower one.See the ladder

About the Elo system

Every SMP player has an Elo rating. Win a fight and it goes up; lose and it drops. Beating a higher-rated player is worth more than beating a lower-rated one, so climbing means taking on the best.

Your rating decides your classification on the leaderboard:

  • Rookie700+
  • Combat Novice950+
  • Combat Cadet1200+
  • Combat Specialist1450+
  • Combat Ace1700+
  • Combat Master1950+

Server rules

The baseline expectations for everyone in Relique. Breaking these gets you muted, kicked, or banned depending on severity — staff have final say.

Discord and general

General conduct

  1. Be respectful. No harassment, hate speech, or targeted insults — in text, voice, or DMs between members while representing the server.
  2. No spam or self-promo. Don't flood channels, mass-mention people, or advertise other servers/content without staff approval.
  3. Keep it SFW. No NSFW content, links, or usernames/profile pictures anywhere in the server.
  4. Use the right channel. Keep discussion on-topic — general chat for chat, support channels for help requests, etc.
  5. No cheating or exploits. X-ray, hacked clients, duplication glitches, and known bugs are bannable. Report bugs to staff instead of abusing them.
  6. Listen to staff. Moderator and admin decisions are final in the moment — appeal through the proper channel if you disagree.

In-game rules

Combat & PvP

  1. No combat logging. This includes vision logging and chase logging. Combat timer is 1 minute.
  2. No Elytra in combat or vision.
  3. Banned in combat: End Crystals, Respawn Anchors, and bed bombing.
  4. TNT minecarts are allowed only for traps.

Cheats & Exploits

  1. No duping, hacking, cheating, or glitch abuse.
  2. No hacked clients, world maps, seed cracking, or similar tools.
  3. Minimap, Freecam, and FriendGuard mods are not allowed.
  4. Replay is allowed but must not be used unfairly.

World & Gameplay

  1. The End is closed until the End War event.
  2. Do not interfere in ongoing cases.
  3. No loophole abuse.

Spawn rules

  1. No PvP, ambushes, or griefing at spawn.
  2. Do not break or place unnecessary blocks at spawn.
  3. No FriendGuard.
  4. No killing players at spawn who are building.
  5. No fighting inside spawn. This will be strictly enforced.
  6. Do not run into spawn during a fight to save yourself. Doing so will result in punishment.
  7. Do not use /home or any teleport commands while within range of other players, or to escape a fight.

Player safety

  1. New players are protected for their first 30 minutes.
  2. Don't farm naked players at spawn.

Naked player protection

  1. No killing naked players within a 200x200 area of spawn.
  2. If the naked player steals your items or attacks you, you are permitted to kill them.

Teams & alliances

  1. Maximum 10 players per team.
  2. All teams must be registered.
  3. No allied team is allowed.

Temporary alliances

  1. Short-term teaming is allowed only to take down an overpowered player (example: a mace user).
  2. These alliances must end immediately once the threat is gone.
  3. Permanent alliances are not allowed.
  4. Base sharing with temporary allies is not allowed.

Targeting & fairness

  1. Targeting one strong player first in a public fight (including at spawn) is allowed for balance purposes, not favoritism.
  2. Use basic logic and fair judgment during fights.

Enforcement

  1. Abusing the alliance rule to form long-term teams or gain an unfair advantage will result in punishment.
  2. Replay or recording is required as proof. Breaking these rules may result in punishment or removal from the server.

Accounts & IOUs

  1. IOUs require physical proof only.
  2. IOUs with allies or temporary teammates are invalid.

Replay requirement

  1. Replay Mod must be ON at all times.
  2. Replay must not be used unfairly.
  3. No replay means no valid proof.

Important

Replay Mod is not valid hacking proof due to delay. The same applies to Flashback. Replay/Flashback is valid for showing combat logs, vision logs, and similar evidence.

Reports & punishment

  1. Rule breaks must be reported to the owner or an admin.
  2. The reporting player helps choose the punishment from options given by the owner.

Staff enforcement

Enforcement

Warnings & strikes

Most first offenses get a warning. Repeated or severe violations escalate straight to a mute, kick, or ban at staff discretion.

Appeals

Think a punishment was a mistake? Open a ticket in the support channel and a staff member will review it.

Rules are subject to change — check back if you're unsure about something.

Ranked

Every player holds a rank from #1 to #30, and your rank sets your hearts, potion duration, XP gain and extra inventory.

How ranks work

When a season starts, ranks are handed out to everyone who is online. Your rank is not permanent: it can be taken in a fight.

1

Season starts

Every online player is given a rank from #1 to #30.

2

Late joiners

Players who join afterwards automatically receive any leftover ranks.

3

Kill to climb

Killing a player steals their rank, no matter how far apart your ranks are.

4

Perks follow your rank

Hearts, potion duration, XP and extra inventory all scale with it.

Rank perks

Rank #1 gets the most of everything. Each step down gives a little less.

Hearts

20 to 10.5

From #1 down to #30. Unranked players have the vanilla 10.

Potion duration

2.00x to 1.05x

Every potion you drink or get hit by lasts longer. Harmful effects are not extended.

XP gain

3.00x to 1.10x

All XP you earn is multiplied by your rank’s value.

Extra inventory

54 to 15 slots

Top 10 ranks only. Open it with /inv. Items drop if you die.

All 30 ranks

Only the top 10 get extra inventory slots.

Hierarchy Hammer

A special weapon handed out by admins. It can’t be dropped or stored in containers.

5 block dash3 hits to empower40 damage Verdict30s Verdict cooldown10s miss cooldown
SentencingRight-click

Dash 5 blocks forward so you can start hitting. Landing a hit stops the dash cooldown, and missing puts it on a 10 second cooldown. You have to land before you can dash again.

Verdict3 hits in a row

Land 3 hits in a row without missing and your next hit is empowered for 40 damage (20 hearts). Verdict then goes on a 30 second cooldown. Only hits on players count toward the combo.

Fall smashMace bonus

Falling at least 1.5 blocks onto a target with the hammer deals 2x damage.

Player commands

/invOpen your extra inventory. Available to the top 10 ranks.

How charms work

Charms are crafted items that give you an active ability. You carry one in each category (offense, defense and support) and use the one you have selected.

1

Craft

Complete a 15 minute crafting ritual. Each charm can be crafted up to 100 times in total.

2

Equip

Offense, defense and support each hold one charm. Check yours with /charm equipped.

3

Use

Trigger the active charm with /abilityuse. Every ability has its own cooldown.

4

Switch

/cycle changes the active slot, and /withdraw returns a charm to you as an item.

The nine charms

Cooldowns and durations start when you trigger the ability. Select a charm to open its crafting recipe.

Warrior

90s cooldown15s duration
AbilityLifesteal

Heals 1.6 for every hit you land while the charm is active.

Player commands

/charm <keybinds|equipped|crafteds|info|actionbar|CooldownText|togglestealth|togglemagnet>Charm menu and personal settings.
/withdraw <offense|defense|support>Take an equipped charm back as an item.
/cycleSwitch your active charm slot.
/abilityuseUse the active charm’s ability.
/trust <add|remove|list> [player]Manage your trusted players.
/checkcharms <player>View another player’s equipped charms.

Charm cooldowns, durations, damage numbers and recipes come straight from the plugin config. Staff can switch charm crafting on or off, so check Announcements for the current status.
